# TPC-H Q14 — Promotion Effect

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpch
```

> [TPC-H](../../tpc-h.md) benchmark · [all TPC-H queries](index.md)

Effect of promotions on revenue

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT 100.00 * SUM(CASE WHEN p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS promo_revenue FROM lineitem, part WHERE l_partkey = p_partkey AND l_shipdate >= CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE) AND l_shipdate < CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH'
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q14_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """TPC-H Q14: Promotion Effect (Expression Family).

    Monitors the effect of promotions on revenue.
    """
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    part = ctx.get_table("part")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(14)
    start_date = params["start_date"]
    end_date = params["end_date"]

    return (
        lineitem.filter((col("l_shipdate") >= lit(start_date)) & (col("l_shipdate") < lit(end_date)))
        .join(part, left_on="l_partkey", right_on="p_partkey")
        .select(
            (
                lit(100.0)
                * (col("l_extendedprice") * (lit(1) - col("l_discount")))
                .filter(col("p_type").str.starts_with("PROMO"))
                .sum()
                / (col("l_extendedprice") * (lit(1) - col("l_discount"))).sum()
            ).alias("promo_revenue")
        )
    )
```
